Theme.label: UI theme
Theme.description: Colors for the game's interface, applied on top of the color scheme chosen in the game's options (Colorblind Assist keeps its own status colors). Off: the game's scheme as is. In game, Ctrl+Alt+Plus and Ctrl+Alt+Minus switch themes for the session.

Developer.label: Dump colors on scheme change
Developer.description: Writes every interface color to data\Logs\DW2UIThemes\scheme-n.json each time the game applies a color scheme.
